product.name: Future Ready Conversion OS
compliance_obligations: Malaysia Personal Data Protection Act 2010 Act 709 as amended

delivery.current_slice: visitor selects intent and cohort, submits once, receives durable acknowledgement, and the programme team receives a retryable lifecycle event
acceptance_criteria: a repeated submission_id creates one logical lead
lead success is returned only after durable lead, audit and outbox writes commit
no public route can read or mutate an existing lead
CRM delivery is signed, versioned, retryable and dead-lettered
the two-step form preserves user input after validation or network failure
field analytics contain no names, email addresses, phone numbers or free text
the complete workflow is keyboard and mobile accessible
delivery.next_action: Apply migration 006 in staging, configure webhook secrets, then run the release-readiness gates
known_risks: Hostinger backup and point-in-time recovery capability requires operational verification
production CRM endpoint and data-processing terms are not configured
traffic volume is not yet sufficient for statistically powered experiments
the current Codex session requires restart before Chrome DevTools MCP tools become callable
